packages.title: A safe place to stay tonight
packages.why: Call a shelter first to check for room; 2-1-1 can find one that has space, any time.

packages.title: Getting safe
packages.why: These hotlines answer day and night and can arrange a safe place to stay.
packages.self_step: If you are in danger right now, call 911.

packages.title: Short on rent
packages.why: College emergency money is fastest; the county and community action agencies can add more; legal aid helps if an eviction has started.
packages.self_step: Ask your landlord in writing for a few more days, and keep a copy.

packages.title: Food is running short
packages.why: A campus pantry helps today; SNAP helps every month after.

packages.title: A shut-off notice
packages.why: The winter crisis program and HEAP can stop a shut-off; PIPP Plus keeps the bill steady after.
packages.self_step: Call the utility and ask for a payment plan; tell them you are applying for help.

packages.title: No way to get to class
packages.why: Students ride the bus at a reduced fare, and rides from the door are there for riders with a disability.

packages.title: No child care for class or work
packages.why: The county can pay for part of child care; 4C finds openings that fit your hours.

packages.title: A hard week
packages.why: Talking to someone helps, and so does moving: a walk outside or a free class can lift a hard week.
packages.self_step: If you are thinking about hurting yourself, call or text 988 now.

packages.title: Falling behind in a class
packages.why: Tutoring is free, and accommodations help if a disability is part of it.

packages.title: No photo ID
packages.why: An Ohio state ID is free for residents 17 and older without a driver license.

packages.title: Hours cut or need a job
packages.why: Workforce centers help with jobs and training; your college career office knows jobs that fit a class schedule.

packages.title: Finding your people
packages.why: A center for students like you is a place to belong, and a free class or event is an easy way to meet people.
